evals.prompt: 我在寫一個 NestJS + TypeORM 的 Node.js 專案,想要用 clean architecture 幫我刻一個 Order 實體。欄位有 id (number)、customerId (number)、totalAmount (number)、status (PENDING/PAID/CANCELLED)。業務規則:cancel() 只有 PENDING 狀態可以取消,取消後要發送一個 OrderCancelledEvent。需要串接一個外部 PaymentClient 去查金流狀態(用 client adapter 包起來就好,SDK 細節你自己編)。API 要有 POST /api/orders 建立訂單、PUT /api/orders/{id}/cancel 取消訂單、GET /api/orders/{id} 查詢。這是這個專案第一次刻這種分層,麻煩先幫我確認一下 TDD 流程,先寫測試再寫實作。
evals.expected_output: Full compilable TypeScript clean-architecture layer set for Order (domain/usecase/adapter-outbound/adapter-inbound) on the NestJS+TypeORM+Zod+Vitest stack, plus the one-time shared kernel (domain/usecase errors, event publisher port + Nest adapter, Zod pipe, global exception filter), plus a domain Vitest test written before implementation and a testcontainers-backed controller-level e2e test written after all four layers exist — no separate usecase-mock or adapter-outbound test files.
assertions: Generates the one-time shared kernel files (domain/errors.ts with InvalidStateError/InvalidArgumentError, usecase/errors.ts with NotFoundError, usecase/event-publisher.port.ts, adapter/outbound/event/nest-event-publisher.adapter.ts, adapter/inbound/http/pipes/zod-validation.pipe.ts, adapter/inbound/http/filters/global-exception.filter.ts) since this is stated as the project's first use of the skill
Domain layer (order.ts / order-status.ts) imports no npm packages, only sibling domain files and the shared errors module
Each use case (create, cancel, get) gets its own separate Inbound Port interface file and its own UseCaseImpl file — no single fat interface/class covering all three actions
Every port interface (Inbound and Outbound) has a co-located exported Symbol DI token used via @Inject in the corresponding UseCaseImpl/Controller constructor

The write command (e.g. CreateOrderCommand) is defined as a Zod schema in the usecase layer's command/ folder and imported by the Controller, not redefined as a separate DTO in the adapter/inbound layer

A domain test file (order.spec.ts) is produced and is TDD-ordered before the domain implementation, using Vitest (describe/it, no mocking) — and no separate usecase-layer mock test file (e.g. *.usecase.spec.ts with vi.fn() mocking Outbound Ports) is produced

A controller-level e2e test (order.controller.e2e-spec.ts) is produced only after all four layers exist, starts a real database via testcontainers (not an in-memory sqlite/better-sqlite3 substitute) inside beforeAll/afterAll, and only stubs the third-party PaymentClient — everything else (repository, DB) is real
The e2e test's write-path assertions don't just check the HTTP response — they re-query (e.g. a follow-up GET) to confirm the state actually persisted in the database
No adapter-outbound layer test file (e.g. *.mapper.spec.ts, *.repository-impl.spec.ts) is produced

The OrderRepository Outbound Port uses the standard getById/save signature returning Promise<Order | null> / Promise<Order>, and cancel's UseCaseImpl throws the shared NotFoundError (not a per-entity exception) when getById returns null
The PaymentClient external dependency is placed under adapter/outbound/client/ as a *Adapter class implementing a *Client port, with a custom Error subclass wrapping the underlying failure
The Order Controller does not import anything from the domain/ directory, and returns an OrderResponse wrapping OrderResult from the usecase layer
File names and class names follow the skill's derivation table (kebab-case files with the documented suffixes like .usecase.ts, .repository.ts, .controller.ts; PascalCase classes)

evals.prompt: 同一個專案裡,我還想加一個 Coupon 實體,欄位是 id (number)、code (string)、discountPercent (number)。目前只需要一個 GET /api/coupons/{id} 查詢功能就好,先不用寫測試。這個專案已經有共用的錯誤處理基礎設施了(domain/errors.ts、usecase/errors.ts、usecase/event-publisher.port.ts、adapter/outbound/event/nest-event-publisher.adapter.ts、adapter/inbound/http/pipes/zod-validation.pipe.ts、adapter/inbound/http/filters/global-exception.filter.ts 這幾個檔案在刻 Order 實體時已經產生過),不要重複產生,直接沿用。
evals.expected_output: TypeScript clean-architecture layer set for a read-only Coupon entity (domain/usecase/adapter-outbound/adapter-inbound), reusing the existing shared kernel without regenerating it, no test files since none were requested.
assertions: Does NOT regenerate any of the shared kernel files the user said already exist (domain/errors.ts, usecase/errors.ts, usecase/event-publisher.port.ts, adapter/outbound/event/nest-event-publisher.adapter.ts, pipes/zod-validation.pipe.ts, filters/global-exception.filter.ts)
Produces Coupon domain files (coupon.ts) with no status enum since Coupon has no status field
Produces exactly one Inbound Port + Impl for the single GetCouponUseCase query, not extra create/update/delete use cases that weren't requested

Produces a CouponRepository Outbound Port and CouponRepositoryImpl (TypeORM DataModel + Mapper + RepositoryImpl) even though only a GET endpoint was requested, since persistence is still needed to read the entity
No Command file / Zod schema is produced since there is no write endpoint (GET only, no request body)
No test files (.spec.ts) are produced, matching the user's explicit 'don't write tests' request
Produces a CouponController with a single GET /api/coupons/:id endpoint and a CouponModule wiring the repository and use case tokens
Coupon Controller does not import anything from the domain/ directory
